data.description:
Consolidate the legacy 'query' command (hardcoded pattern matching) with the new 'expr' command (parser-based) into a single unified query system that uses the Query Builder infrastructure.

## Background
- Legacy 'query': ~300 lines of if/elif pattern matching (got_utils.py:2392-2693)
- New 'expr': Modular Lexer→Parser→AST→Executor→Query Builder (cortical/got/expression/)
- Design doc explicitly states expr should REPLACE query (Section 1.5)

## Current Gap
- expr CLI doesn't support function calls (blocked(), in_sprint(), etc.)
- query has natural language patterns expr doesn't support

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] expr CLI supports all function calls
- [ ] Natural language patterns translate to expr syntax
- [ ] query command becomes alias/wrapper for expr
- [ ] Single execution path through Query Builder
- [ ] Backwards compatibility maintained
data.title: Consolidate query and expr into unified query system
